results.name: Starter validates six cases, two customers and one shared Willowbank pump identity
Composition contains only the module and six accessible local views
r20 tokens and embedded Roboto font bytes match the declared source
Filter exclusion clears selected case and prevents opening a hidden record
Customer, site, owner, category and priority filters operate together
Case workspace retains installed location, three served areas and Google Maps address
Same-equipment history exposes the earlier unsuccessful fix without merging cases
Assistant is source-scoped, modeless and has inspectable exact case evidence
Triage adds a technician action while retaining a distinct Service Manager case owner
Waiting retains an owner, review time and active customer-update commitment
Resuming preserves the original waiting decision in history
Outstanding work cannot be transferred back to the same case
Technician preview shows assigned cases and suppresses other customer cases and full backup
Technician can record their action outcome but cannot triage or change case ownership
Photo capture rejects disguised text and creates no retained attachment
Observation upload retains exact original photo bytes, author, basis, target and source
Correcting a finding retains the old observation and one original image identity
Technician submits a sourced resolution proposal without closing the case
Manager return retains the proposal in history and creates an owned correction action
Accepted resolution preserves the source evidence and remains separate from closure
Closure is refused without successful customer contact after the review
Internal discussion cannot stand in for successful customer contact
Recorded contact permits manager closure while clearing the next-update commitment
Reopening retains the case identity, previous closure and all evidence
On-site coordination creates a draft work order and proposed visit without changing case ownership
Linking existing same-site work preserves one work-order identity
Related-case link keeps separate identities and the previous closed case unchanged
Employee intake saves explicit unknowns with a manager owner and separate logger
An employee can complete missing site and equipment details while preserving case identity and the original capture
Employee cannot promote a reported symptom into a verified technical finding
Model rejects unknown-site attendance routing, wrong department assignment and stale versions
Storage change marks sourced assistance stale and blocks copying the old draft
Competing retained data refuses the save and preserves the entered proposal
Reload retains case revisions, closed outcomes, relationships and original image bytes
Backup validation rejects cross-site equipment, invalid instants and missing original cases
Invalid backup is refused without replacing current evidence
Backup replacement requires review and cancellation keeps the current cases
Confirmed restore recovers the validated starter without changing shared context
Native local tabs expose keyboard traversal and matching panel labels
IDs remain unique while a source field and source-inspection dialog coexist
Read-only observer can inspect but cannot capture, triage, wait or assign
Malformed retained data is preserved and disclosed separately from starter data
Storage failure keeps the session change and reports session-only recovery
No uncaught script errors in the exercised model and DOM journeys

limits: jsdom DOM emulation; native dialog, focus/top-layer, menu geometry, image decode (stubbed to a 1px test fixture), browser camera, actual clipboard/downloads and physical-device acceptance remain unverified. No application, backend, security or operational acceptance is claimed.
